description: Source code for checkpoint state dictionary saving utilities in PyTorch's distributed training framework, including functions for saving state dicts synchronously and asynchronously, with support for distributed coordination, staging, and planning.

classes.name: AsyncCheckpointerType
classes.description: Enum for async checkpointer type, with options 'thread' and 'process'.

classes.name: AsyncSaveResponse
classes.description: Data class containing futures for staging and upload completion, returned by async_save.

methods.name: save_state_dict
methods.description: Deprecated function to save a state dict, recommends using 'save' instead.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a distributed model's state dict in SPMD style, handling sharded tensors and DTensors, with optional process group coordination.

methods.name: async_save
methods.description: Asynchronous version of 'save' that stages the state dict and performs save in a separate thread or process, returning futures.

methods.name: _stateful_to_state_dict
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of a state dict, calling 'state_dict' on each 'Stateful' object.

methods.name: _save_state_dict
methods.description: Internal function to handle the actual saving of a state dict with distributed coordination, planning, and writing.
